components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important local action. Clay-on-dark fill on the dark canvas; Clay strong on light.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(17.5 67.1% 69%); color: hsl(252 10.2% 9.6%); padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px/20px Lexend, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(17.5 67.1% 63%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(17.5 67.1% 69%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: A quiet field for search and filters.
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(270 6.9% 22.7%); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(252 10.2% 9.6%); color: hsl(38.6 31.8% 91.4%); font: 400 14px/20px Lexend, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: hsl(36 9.2% 68%); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(17.5 67.1% 69%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Grouped Surface
components.description: A bordered, quiet surface for information that belongs together.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid hsl(270 6.9% 22.7%); border-radius: 14px; background: hsl(260 9.1% 12.9%); color: hsl(38.6 31.8% 91.4%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card p { font-size: 14px; color: hsl(36 9.2% 68%); margin: 0; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact text-first context for a categorical state.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border: 1px solid hsl(270 6.9% 22.7%); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: hsl(38.6 31.8% 91.4%); font: 500 12px/16px Lexend, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Quiet Navigation Item
components.description: A sidebar route with a modest active wash and clear label.
components.html: Bank Transactions
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 10px; color: hsl(38.6 31.8% 91.4%); font: 400 14px/20px Lexend, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: hsl(262.5 9.1% 17.3%); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(17.5 67.1% 69%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; }

narrative.northStar: Quiet paper-and-ink record with a scarce clay signal
narrative.overview:
Tempo is a private personal-finance overview and bank account tracker: balances, transactions, categories, and cash movement in one calm view. The interface is quiet and trustworthy, data-forward without density for its own sake, and distinctive through proportion, spacing, and a small number of deliberate forms — never through effects.

The authenticated product is primarily an Operate experience: a screen should make the current financial state, the next useful action, and the path to inspect detail obvious. Dark, light, and system themes are first-class; dark is a warm Night canvas, light is warm Paper — the same clay identity in both.
keyCharacteristics: Data-forward without being dense for its own sake.
Clay accent, scarce and warm, on a paper-and-ink field.
Mostly flat tonal layers with transient elevation.
Precise numbers paired with plain-language status.

rules.name: The Quiet Signal Rule
rules.body: Tempo earns attention with hierarchy and relevance first. Color, motion, and ornament are supporting signals, never the content of the screen.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Clay is scarce enough to remain meaningful. A screen has a clear primary action or active state, not a clay wash.

rules.name: The Plain Number Rule
rules.body: Monetary values and dates stay easy to scan, compare, and copy.

rules.name: The Record Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: The financial record is the visual subject. No decorative headers, metric-tile mosaics, or hero space before the data.

dos: Make state, task, and next action clear before visual personality.
Treat Clay as a scarce, meaningful signal on a paper/ink field.
Verify dark, light, and system themes, keyboard focus, reduced motion, and narrow widths before calling a surface finished.
Use real product terminology and honest data states; label synthetic data as synthetic.
donts: Don't use blue/violet gradients, glassmorphism, glowing borders, or metric-tile rows.
Don't make every section a card or every action a pill.
Don't introduce a second accent color or decorative gradients without a product reason.
Don't fabricate balances, transactions, financial claims, or synchronization outcomes.
Don't change typography, the radius vocabulary, or theme behavior as a side effect.
